segments.name: Residential MBS
segments.description: Invests mainly in fixed rate, adjustable rate and hybrid adjustable rate residential MBS issued or guaranteed by U.S. GSEs or Ginnie Mae.
segments.evidence: We operate in the U.S. and invest primarily in fixed rate residential, adjustable rate and hybrid adjustable rate residential MBS issued or guaranteed by U.S. GSEs or guaranteed by Ginnie Mae.

revenueModel.text: Security holders receive principal and interest passed through from pools of mortgage loans, collected by the issuer or servicer.
revenueModel.evidence: The pass-through issuer or servicer collects the payments on the loans in the pool and "passes through" the principal and interest to the security holders on a pro rata basis.
